The FloPlast solvent weld 3-boss double socket short pipe is a robust uPVC component for efficient soil and vent drainage systems. Designed for secure and long-lasting plumbing connections, this black 110mm pipe offers strength and ease of installation using solvent weld joints. Its three 67mm boss inlets accommodate 32mm and 40mm waste pipes, making it ideal for connecting multiple fixtures in various applications. The double socket design allows straightforward extension within existing soil stack layouts, ensuring a versatile and reliable solution for trade professionals. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing
